params.body type: a petite, lithe and graceful figure with a modest bust, a slim waist and gently rounded hips

prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images. For the image tool, omit referenced_image_paths and num_last_images_to_include.

SOURCE: Spearow (깨비참), normal / flying type.

PALETTE: brown, light pink.

STYLE: Polished Japanese-anime gacha character illustration in clean 2D: crisp thin dark linework, large finely detailed glossy eyes with layered highlights and a soft blush, very fine detailed hair rendered as many thin strands with sparkling highlights along every lock, soft airy cel-to-gradient shading with a natural sunlit sheen — soft, broad highlights from real outdoor daylight on her skin, gloves, stockings and armor, never wet, oily or plastic-looking, and a bright high-key look where the highlights glow toward white while the darkest accents stay deep and clean. A low-saturation pastel palette dominated by white, silver and soft light tones, with one deep accent colour; gentle bloom and small sparkle particles in the air. Keep the face and body visibly illustrated in 2D; no 3D render or photorealistic appearance.

SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Spearow as her motif — the creature reimagined as an armored adult woman, not a mascot costume or a creature suit: her plates, undersuit, hair and ornaments carry its palette, markings and shapes. She wears its features as costume; nothing is carried, mounted or put on display. Her skin is human skin.

WEAR: the three brown tail feathers become a feathered or ruffled collar and trim; its markings (two thin, horizontal stripes) become painted lines and patterns on her plates and undersuit.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): sharp face, balanced length, medium width; narrow tapered chin; narrow eyes, small size, level outer corners, close-set; angled brows; straight slender bridge nose; thin lips.

FORM — LIGHT: one close-fitting armor layer: slim plates at the shoulders, forearms, hips and shins over a fitted undersuit, joints free; the armor's outline stays slim and readable without slimming her figure. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.

MECHA SILHOUETTE: several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth. Solid hard-surface plates that read as armor, not cloth.

TYPE EFFECTS: One open hand conjuring a warm white-gold light amid soft floating motes of warm light. A pale sky-blue glow with white wind streaks pulses along her armor seams and joints. A soft ring of warm light spreads over the floor beneath her boots.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that is also this form's card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion. Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face. Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

IDENTITY (chosen details override the automatic look)
body type: a petite, lithe and graceful figure with a modest bust, a slim waist and gently rounded hips
body scope: Body type sets the build; body details adjust within it. These describe anatomy beneath armor, not equipment volume.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Keep both hands relaxed — a loose fist, an open palm or resting on something. Gloves are full-finger and close-fitting; plates, water, sparks and effects stay off the fingers.
